name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Use previously refrigerated cooked rice. Fry chopped onion in oil, scramble egg until firm, add rice, heat until steaming hot.

name: Tomato Omelette
instructions: Wash and chop vegetables, beat egg, cook mixture in a lightly oiled pan until fully set.

name: Banana Oat Bowl
instructions: Heat oats in milk until cooked and thickened. Top with sliced banana.

name: Chickpea Salad
instructions: Wash vegetables, dice, then combine with cooked chickpeas and lemon juice.

name: Garlic Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Gently sauté garlic in oil, add tomato, combine with drained pasta.

name: Potato and Egg Hash
instructions: Dice and cook potatoes until tender; fry onions and potatoes, add eggs and cook until fully set.

name: Tuna Sandwich
instructions: Drain commercially canned tuna, mix with lemon juice, layer with washed cucumber on bread. Eat promptly.

name: Vegetable Rice Bowl
instructions: Wash and slice vegetables. Cook until soft, stir in cooked rice and heat until steaming hot.
